book.name: Galɛshiaŋ
book.title: Ŋwa wù Bol gɛ̀ saŋ fɛ kintaashɛ ki Galɛshiaŋ le

content: Kletu le wu bvusɛ wa besabɛŋ yi bvunfa le

Kletu gɛ̀ bvusɛ wa besabɛŋ yi bvunfa le. Wu gɛ̀ bvuse nɛ, wu lɛ keefɛ besabɛŋ ka be nyûme a bvunfa bvu banchi kuu gɛ. Noo, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ lɛ̂me bɛŋ tɛɛme. Keefɛ bɛŋ ka bɛŋ lêe akuu a kimbuŋ ki bvunfa le gɛ.
Bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû fiɛɛ fì mɛ wù Bol nlé njɛ̂mɛ. Nɛ bɛŋ bɛme lo lɛ ba chvûu bɛŋ yeh fɛ bɛŋ nyû chaaŋ a Nyo jii, tu fiɛɛ fì Kletu gɛ̀ ge fɛ bɛŋ le le achiji.
Ŋka njɛme nchiise lɛ muh wuchii wù le wu bɛɛŋ lɛ ba chvûu wu yeh wu kêe lɛ wu kɛ̂me ki wu gɛ̂ɛde banchi ba Bajuu bachii no bo le.
Bɛŋ bachii ba goone ki bɛŋ nyû jialɛ sɛŋ a Nyo jii le nje bɛŋ gɛɛde banchi, bɛŋ kêe lɛ bɛŋ le bɛŋ ŋga wa bikwɛɛ biɛna bɛ Kletu. Bɛŋ le bɛŋ bvusɛ wa ye yene yi mbalɛ wù Nyo bale bɛŋ yu le.

Fɛ besabɛŋ le, fiɛɛ fì besabɛŋ jiiŋe fwe yi fi le, le lɛ Nyo lé wu gê wu jô besabɛŋ njɛ bamii ba le chaaŋ a wu jii. Finɛ le fiɛɛ fì Kiyo ki Nyo kì lɛne yi ye yese besabɛŋ le fede yi fitele fì besabɛŋ leese yi Kletu le fi ge wa lɛ besabɛŋ chîɛɛne.

Bɛŋ kêe lɛ nɛ muh le wu taashɛ wa bɛ Kletu Jiso, wu nyume ba chvuu wu yeh kɛnɛ ba baaŋ chvuu gɛ wu yeh gɛ, tu gɛh fifiɛɛ kɛme fiɛɛ ki fi gê gɛ. Fiɛɛ fì le fishaŋ le fitele fì wu lesɛ yi Kletu le, wu duunyi yi kiŋkoŋɛ le.
Bɛŋ chi shee bɛŋ gee chuule, ge yɛɛŋ lɛ bɛŋ lû ki bɛŋ bîi nchiɛɛŋ le?
Gɛ nyu Nyo wù gɛ̀ tɛŋɛ bɛŋ wu tefɛ bɛŋ a yinɛ je le gɛ.
Gɛ bɛŋ kwaji ŋgaŋ wù ba to ba ma lɛ, “Kikuu kimimia chɛŋe bɛ nchwa gɛ?”
Ŋgɛɛde bvufee yi ye yene le nje Tada lɛ gɛ bɛŋ bii fiɛɛ fì bamii bamu jɛme le fuge fì jɛme mɛ gɛ. Lɛ muh wɛɛ wù chɛŋe bɛ bvufee bwena, kɛnɛ le yɛɛŋ, le Nyo wù lé wu nôŋ ŋgɛ yi ye ye le.

Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, nɛ fi bee lɛ mbaaŋ nfeeji lɛ ba chvûse bamii yeh fɛ bo nyûme chaaŋ a Nyo jii, bamii ka bo boone bikaa a mɛ jiŋ nje la? Nɛ fi bee noo tu fiɛɛ fì nfeeji lɛ Kletu gɛ̀ kwe yi kintaaŋ le, bamii yuge bo ka baŋse lo yu, fi gɛ ka fi nyu yu gɛ.
Fɛ bamii baa ba njiŋse bɛ bvufee bwena, ŋgoone lɛ ba gɛ̂ɛŋ fwe ba mɛ̂sɛ ba bvûushɛ lo ye yiboo.

Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, Nyo gɛ̀ tɛɛŋ wa bɛŋ wu lɛ keefɛ bɛŋ ka bɛŋ nyû nfa yi fiɛɛ fimi le gɛ. Geenɛ, no bɛŋ baaŋ gɛ yi bvunfa le gɛ, keefɛ bɛŋ mo bɛŋ jôde lɛ taŋlo bɛŋ gêe mwɛɛ mù mbefe no nyaŋ yi ye yene goone gɛ. Bɛŋ lɛ̂ne lo lɛme fɛ booŋ ba bwe bena le bɛ kiŋkoŋɛ.
Bɛŋ gêe noo nje banchi bachii le bo taashɛ yi wunɛ le wu mumwaa lɛ,

content.text: “Wo kôŋe muh wù le mbebe yo le gɛh no wo koŋe kikwɛɛ kuŋ.”

content: Geenɛ, bɛŋ nɛ ja bɛŋ tu bɛŋ ŋase lɛbɛŋlɛbɛŋ njɛ bvú, muh goone ki wu lûŋ wu jî lo mwa bwee, bɛŋ yɛ̂ne lɛ keefɛ bɛŋ gê bɛŋ jâ bɛŋ chɛ̂ŋɛ bɛ bikwɛɛ biɛna gɛ.
Gɛ muh wù chee no Kiyo ki Nyo duunyito wu ka wu gee no nyaŋ yi ye goone gɛ
Fiɛɛ fì njɛme le lɛ, bɛŋ chêe bɛŋ bii gɛh no Kiyo ki Nyo duunyi bɛŋ le, noo bɛŋ gɛ ka bɛŋ gêe no nyaŋ yi ye yene goone lɛ bɛŋ gêe gɛ.

Njɛme nɛ nje gɛ fiɛɛ fì nyaŋ yi ye goone to fi chɛŋsɛ a fi Kiyo ki Nyo goone le gɛ. Gɛ fì Kiyo ki Nyo goone tɛ fi chɛŋsɛ a fì nyaŋ yi ye goone le gɛ. Gɛ mwɛɛ mù munfɛɛ munɛ taŋlo mu nyûme yì fiɛɛ le fimimia gɛ. Nɛ fiɛɛ fì gɛ taŋlo bɛŋ gêe fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ goone gɛ.
Nɛ bɛŋ chee bɛŋ bii nyu no Kiyo ki Nyo duunyi bɛŋ le, bɛŋ gɛ ka bɛŋ nyû a banchi ba Musɛ kuu gɛ.
Mwɛɛ mù mbefe mù nyaŋ yi ye to yi goone gɛh bamii maa mu gɛ. Le ki ba jâŋe kinjaŋ bɛ ki ba kwâji mwɛɛ kune kinjaŋ mo ki ba chêe kinche ki nyiɛŋ yi kinjaŋ.

Ka nyume ki ba bûune banyo ba achiji bɛ ki ba lâde kɛnɛ ba fîɛŋe jiaaŋ. Ka nyume ki bâne kimbanɛ, ki ba ŋâse kiŋase, ki ba ghɛ̂ge kiŋghɛ, ki ba kɛ̂me shɛ́ŋ yì toonyi bɛ fɛ muh kwâji gɛh nyu kikwɛɛ ke. Ka nyume ki ba gâse bamii mo fɛ muh gâ bamii wu kɛme ke kinchvu.

Le tɛ ki ba bɛ̂ɛne kindoŋ, ki ba mûu mbvuuŋ ma kôode bɛ ki bo mûu bo yôde, mo ki bo gêe mumu mwɛɛ njɛ munɛ. Njɛme nchiise no ŋgɛ̀ njɛmɛ wa bɛŋ le fweele, lɛ bamii ba gee munɛ mwɛɛ gɛ bo nyu bo kɛ̂me kijusɛ antɛnɛɛ a bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo gɛ.
Geenɛ, mwɛɛ mù jade fɛ Kiyo ki Nyo le, le munɛ, kiŋkoŋɛ, kilaŋye, nyiɛgee, ŋkanɛ shɛ́ŋ, kiŋge kì joŋe, bvujoŋɛ, ki muh lɛme yi nchiɛɛŋ le,
kiŋge kì bonɛ, mo ki muh jiji ye ye le. Gɛ nchi wumu nyume yu wù banɛ mwɛɛ munɛ gɛ.
Bamii ba le ba Kletu Jiso le ba ta wa nyaŋ yi ye yiboo bɛ mwɛɛ mù mbefe mù nyaŋ yi ye goone yi kintaaŋ ki Jiso le.
No besabɛŋ chee mɛɛse yi bvuŋga bvu Kiyo ki Nyo le, besabɛŋ mo be gêe mwɛɛ bee bîi gɛh no Kiyo kiyu duunyi.
Keefɛ besabɛŋ chîaase ye gɛ. Keefɛ besabɛŋ gêe muntele befe bamii bamu gɛ. Keefɛ besabɛŋ bɛ̂ɛne kindoŋ bɛ bamii bamu gɛ.
